name: Ranko
source:
Self proclaimed producer and manager, Ranko is a mature former Idol that couldn't make it big in her early twenties. Now, with the fears of adulthood haunting her, she bets it all in her latest idea..."Lewd Idol Project."
She'll try to introduce [url=/c121473]Kairi[/url] into the world of "lewd idols" in order to fulfill her frustrated dream.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1604800/]Steam[/url]]
